text:
anya: Heads up — QA on the new 7B bring-up found a weird conversion bug from HF jinja chat_template -> Redwood prompt. system message trailing newline is getting dropped and role boundaries collapse.

sam: ouch. do you have a tiny repro we can look at?

anya: yeah, minimal Jinja that triggers it:

```
{% if user %}
- role: system
  content: |
    You are an assistant.
    Please follow the rules.

- role: user
  content: {{ user }}
{% else %}
- role: user
  content: "{{ user }}"
{% endif %}
```

anya: HF's chat_template keeps that blank line after the system block; our converter trims it when rendering into a single prompt string, which makes the tokenizer glue system+user and later the runtime interprets it as a single assistant turn.

marta: very likely a `strip()` call or join behavior in the converter. also check model `config.json` special tokens — some models explicitly set `additional_special_tokens: ["<|system|>"]` and our token-preserve logic was skipping them.

eval-bot: quick eval snapshot: after conversion bug -> HellaSwag acc drops 2.1% (baseline 78.3 -> 76.2) and perplexity on LM eval increased by ~3.6% on a small prompt set. Quantized int8 run amplified the drop.

sam: thanks — two-prong fix: (1) preserve trailing newlines in system blocks when rendering, (2) make converter inject an explicit sentinel token we own when role boundary detected, e.g. `---RW_ROLE_BREAK---` instead of relying on whitespace.

marta: agreed. add a unit test that renders templates with `|` multiline blocks and verifies `role` split after tokenization. also add a regression harness for the eval set to catch the 2% swing.

anya: I'll paste the quick patch I'm testing:

```
# converter snippet
block = jinja_render(block_template)
if block.endswith('\n'):
    prompt_parts.append(block)  # preserve final newline
else:
    prompt_parts.append(block + '\n')
# ensure explicit sentinel between roles
prompt = '---RW_ROLE_BREAK---'.join(prompt_parts)
```

sam: looks good. please also account for models that use `additional_special_tokens` so we don't double-insert; fallback to sentinel only when tokenizer would merge tokens.

marta: putting a small tracker ticket: #INF-4219 — converter: preserve role break newlines + sentinel fallback. I'll add testcases and a small eval job.

anya: thanks, team. will post results after the int8 eval runs (expecting it to recover ~1.8% if sentinel applied).

sam: :thumbsup: if anyone sees other templates (especially with trailing `\n\n`) please drop them here so we can expand tests.

eval-bot: queued eval job 9942 for int8 + sentinel patch. will report after run finishes.
